description: Redirects for the retired video, voice, interactive-live-streaming, and broadcast-streaming folders, whose pages moved to rtc. scripts/generate-legacy-redirect-artifacts.mjs merges `redirects` into vercel.json after the vercel.base.json redirects. `expectations` lists every retired page URL, including its published platform URLs, with the destination it must reach. See docs/agents/reports/2026-09-15-rtc-folder-redirect-mapping.md.
